poseOrder: Exact row-major order 0–11: 0,1,2=punch, unarmed close hand strike preparation / extension to contact / balanced recovery; 3,4,5=heavy, stronger shoulder/elbow hand strike preparation / contact follow-through / recovery; 6,7,8=low, low sweep preparation / extended leg sweep / recovery; 9=hit, ordinary non-graphic recoil, complete body; 10=ko, controlled lowering onto one knee; 11=ko, complete full-body side-lying rest/fallen pose, modest neutral non-graphic pose with both legs/boots entirely visible. No blood or wounds.
